message:
Last week, we had a surprise power outage that lasted a couple of hours. As I rummaged through my drawer for the trusty flashlight, my phone buzzed with messages from the family group chat. My daughter was sharing updates about her pantry snacks, while my son was sending funny memes to lighten the mood — it turned into a mini party of sorts! 

I had my power bank handy to keep my phone charged, and we swapped tips about making the most of our time without electricity. It reminded me how important it is to stay connected, even when the lights go out. 

How do you keep the family spirit alive during a blackout? I'd love to hear your tips!
